name: podium
title: Podium
description: The top three as the three-block shape: second left, first centre and tallest, third right. Not a short leaderboard, because the arrangement is the point and the DOM order has to stay 1, 2, 3 for a screen reader and for a render with no stylesheet. Each place carries `data-gs-rank` and the score inside it is a `stat` carrying `data-gs-value`. Rank movement is the sign of `data-gs-delta`. Places travel over the reorder token and stop dead under reduced motion. Performs nothing: the host hands the places over already ranked.
docs: Pass `places` in rank order; anything past the third is dropped. The visual arrangement comes from `order` keyed on `data-gs-rank`, so the DOM stays in rank order and the podium reads correctly with the stylesheet off. Set `you` on the player's place for the marked treatment and the word the accessible-name table fixes. An empty podium renders `data-gs-empty="true"` with a designed empty case; pass `emptyAction` to give it the next step. Player names are rendered as text, never as markup. Installs into `components/gamestage/podium/` rather than flat beside the others, so that its relative import of `stat` resolves to the same file in an installed app as it does in this repo. Changing the target to a flat file breaks that import.
